content.short: Adaverse is a crypto-native venture firm backing blockchain founders in high-adoption Web3 markets today.
content.description: Adaverse is a crypto-native venture firm focused on founders building blockchain products for markets with real adoption. The team describes itself as founders, technologists, and builders helping startups access regions where decentralization is used, trusted, and needed. Its work spans investment, portfolio support, market access, and ecosystem building for Web3 teams. Within the Cardano context, Adaverse is known as an investor and accelerator connected to emerging-market blockchain growth and adoption.
